Xachosian Eardwellers cannot reach maturity outside of the plane of dreams, so these poor things are doomed, and will expire in about an hour. Supposedly, they are (barely) edible. |notes =
:* 3 Xachosian Larvae spawn in your inventory after the Xachosian Eardweller's disease effect wears off naturally. Cannot be mail, banked, or auctioned, but can be traded. Expire after one hour or logout. :* The 60 minutes timer has quirks: It seems to pause when you enter to a (different) public area. See [[Item_talk:Xachosian_Larva|talk page]] for more info. :* {{Unverified|The spell point restoration effect seems to give 5 spell points per 6 seconds for 120 seconds, for a total of 100 spell points per larvae consumed.}} In March 2016 reported to heal ~57 SP per larva{{Ref|1={{Ddovault|num=1457973091}}}}. |Category1 = Consumable items }}
